home.pill_text: Powered by Gemini AI | Real-Time Restaurant Operations
home.hero_desc: RestaurantBrain AI is a modern restaurant management platform that combines real-time restaurant operations with Gemini AI to simplify menu management, order processing, reservations, staff coordination, and business insights through one intelligent dashboard.
home.features_desc: Everything you need to manage your restaurant seamlessly.
home.feat_1_desc: AI-driven insights to streamline your daily tasks and reduce manual errors by 80%.
home.feat_2_desc: Forecast demand, optimize inventory, and never run out of your best-selling items.
home.feat_3_desc: Keep customers informed with live order tracking and precise preparation time estimates.
home.testimonial: "RestaurantBrain transformed our chaotic kitchen into a well-oiled machine. The UI is absolutely gorgeous and so intuitive."
home.feat_ai_desc: Use Gemini AI to analyze restaurant operations, answer business questions, and generate intelligent recommendations.
home.feat_order_desc: Synchronize customers, kitchen staff, waiters, and restaurant owners through a live order workflow.
home.feat_role_desc: Dedicated dashboards for Customer, Staff, and Restaurant Owner. Secure access to only the features they need.
home.feat_menu_desc: Create categories. Manage menu items. Update pricing. Track item availability.
home.feat_res_desc: Allow customers to book tables. Approve or reject reservations. Manage seating efficiently.
home.feat_kds_desc: Kitchen staff receive orders instantly. Update order progress from Received to Completed.
home.feat_notif_desc: Receive real-time alerts for New Orders, Reservation Updates, Order Status Changes, and Operational Events.
home.feat_analytics_desc: Monitor Revenue, Orders, Reservations, Restaurant Health Score, and Business Performance.
home.step_1_desc: Customers browse the menu, place orders, and reserve tables.
home.step_2_desc: Kitchen staff prepare orders while waiters manage deliveries and table service.
home.step_3_desc: Gemini AI analyzes operational data and generates business insights, recommendations, and summaries for restaurant owners.
home.cta_desc: Experience a smarter way to manage restaurant operations using AI-powered insights and real-time collaboration.
